task.title: P6-053: Add print/share affordance and partial-quantity ticking to needs pick list
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 5 — Missing capability). Original id: P6-053. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**The needs pick list has no print/share affordance, and no way to tick a partial quantity** — `PickRowView`'s `toggle` takes `want: bool` (`needs.rs:780`), so a line where you pulled 2 of 3 is all-or-nothing.
